2610.11862.title: LEVER: Adaptive Cost-Aware Proof Search Over AND/OR Graphs
2610.11862.paper_summary: Mathematicians value proofs for more than correctness: among correct proofs, simplicity, purity and the computational cost of finding them vary widely. Yet LLM-powered theorem provers largely search for any correct proof, and improve its quality only after it is found. We propose LEVER, a proof search algorithm that makes the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizes it during search. LEVER scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph, combining realized objective values with predictions for open subgoals, so the objective guides search before a proof is complete. The same mechanism optimizes computational cost, proof length, topical impurity, and even their weighted combinations, while the Lean kernel enforces correctness. On PutnamBench in Lean 4, under matched budgets, LEVER costs 34% less than a strong single-conversation agent while raising the solve rate from 80% to 96%. On reducing topical impurity, i.e., how far a proof strays from its theorem's subject, it improves over post-hoc refactoring (42% reduction against 33%) at two-thirds of the cost and more reliably; on proof length, the metric refactoring is built for, it approaches refactoring. Varying the objective's weights traces a quality-cost trade-off curve, so the user can choose how much a better proof is worth. Overall, LEVER is a performant, cost-efficient and tunable proof search algorithm for navigating the space of correct proofs.
2610.11862.paper_summary_zh: 數學家對證明的重視不僅僅在於其正確性：在正確的證明中，簡潔性、純粹性和尋找它們的計算成本差異很大。 然而，LLM 驅動的定理證明者主要尋找任何正確的證明，並且僅在找到後才改善其質量。 我們提出了 LEVER，一種證明搜尋算法，使正確證明的目標可編程，並在搜尋過程中進行優化。 LEVER 在 AND/OR 證明圖上對部分證明進行評分，將實現的目標值與未解子目標的預測相結合，因此目標在證明完成之前就指導搜尋。 相同的機制優化計算成本、證明長度、主題不純性，甚至它們的加權組合，而 Lean 核心則強制執行正確性。 在 Lean 4 的 PutnamBench 上，在匹配預算下，LEVER 的成本比強大的單次對話代理低 34%，同時將解決率從 80% 提高到 96%。 在減少主題不純性方面，即證明與其定理主題的偏離程度，它在成本的三分之二下，對後期重構的改進（42% 的減少對 33%）更為可靠；在證明長度方面，該指標重構是為此而建，它接近重構。 變化目標的權重描繪出質量-成本的權衡曲線，因此用戶可以選擇更好的證明值多少。 總體而言，LEVER 是一種高效、成本效益高且可調整的證明搜尋算法，用於導航正確證明的空間。
